accepted.question_text: Let n >= 5 be odd, say n = 2m + 1 > 3, and let M = Γ\AdS^n be a compact anti-de Sitter manifold, where AdS^n is n-dimensional anti-de Sitter space and Γ is a discrete subgroup of its isometry group acting properly discontinuously. Must Γ, up to conjugacy, be a uniform lattice in U(m,1)?

evidence.quote: Question 2.1. Suppose n = 2m + 1 > 3. Let M = Γ\AdSn be a compact AdS manifold, where Γ is a discrete group of isometries acting properly discontinuously on AdSn. Is Γ necessarily a uniform lattice in U(m, 1) (up to conjugacy)?

accepted.question_text: Fix a closed hyperbolic surface S. Let Adm(S) be the set of admissible pairs (j, ρ) in Hom(π1(S), PSL2(R))^2 with j Fuchsian and with the associated action on AdS^3 proper and cocompact. How many connected components does Adm(S) have, and what is the topology of each component?

evidence.quote: Question 2.2. How many connected components does the space Adm(S) have? What is its topology?

accepted.question_text: For a compact anti-de Sitter 3-manifold of the form Γ\AdS^3 with Γ = {(j(γ), ρ(γ)) : γ in π1(S)} coming from an admissible pair (j, ρ) for a closed hyperbolic surface S, which real numbers can occur as the volume of Γ\AdS^3? In particular, is the volume determined only by the Euler number of ρ, or can it vary inside a fixed connected component of Adm(S)?

evidence.quote: Question 2.3. Which values can the volume of a compact AdS 3-manifold take? For Γ = {(j(γ), ρ(γ)) : γ ∈ π1(S)} with (j, ρ) ∈ Adm(S), does the volume of Γ\AdS3 depend only on the Euler number of ρ, or does it vary when (j, ρ) varies in a given connected component of Adm(S)?

accepted.question_text: Let S be a closed surface of genus at least 2, let M = S × R, and let l_- and l_+ be measured laminations on S that fill S. Does there exist exactly one globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter structure h on M whose convex core boundary has measured bending laminations l_- and l_+ on its two boundary components?

evidence.quote: Question 3.1. If l− and l+ are two measured laminations which fill S, is there a unique GHMC AdS structure h on M such that l− and l+ are the measured bending laminations of the boundary of the convex core?

accepted.question_text: Let S be a closed surface of genus at least 2 and let l_- and l_+ be measured laminations on S that fill S. If El(l_-) and El(l_+) denote the corresponding right earthquakes of Teichmüller space T(S), does the composition El(l_-) ∘ El(l_+) have exactly one fixed point in T(S)?

evidence.quote: Question 3.2. Let l−, l+ be two measured laminations which fill S. Does the composition El(l−) ◦ El(l+) have a unique fixed point in T ?

accepted.question_text: Let S be a closed surface of genus at least 2, let T be its Teichmüller space, and let m_- and m_+ be two hyperbolic metrics in T. Is there exactly one globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter structure h on M = S × R such that the induced metrics on the two connected components of the boundary of its convex core are m_- and m_+?
accepted.context_brief: Induced metrics on convex core boundary

evidence.quote: Question 3.3. Let m−, m+ ∈ T . Is there a unique h ∈ GH such that the induced metric on the two connected components of the boundary of the convex core are m− and m+?

accepted.question_text: For the map U : T(S) × T(S) -> T(S) × T(S) defined by taking a pair of hyperbolic metrics (h_l, h_r) to the pair (h_-, h_+) of midpoints of the left and right earthquake edges joining h_l to h_r, is U a homeomorphism?

evidence.quote: Question 3.4. Is U a homeomorphism?

accepted.question_text: Let S be a closed surface and let h_- and h_+ be two Riemannian metrics on S with curvature strictly less than -1 everywhere. Is there exactly one anti-de Sitter 3-manifold N with smooth, space-like, strictly convex boundary such that the induced metrics on the two connected components of ∂N are h_- and h_+, respectively?
accepted.context_brief: Smooth strictly convex AdS boundary metrics

evidence.quote: Question 3.5. Let h−, h+ be two metrics on S with curvature κ < −1. Is there a unique AdS manifold N with smooth, space-like, strictly convex boundary such that the induced metrics on the two connected components of ∂N are equal respectively to h− and h+?

accepted.question_text: Let S be a closed surface and let h_- and h_+ be hyperbolic metrics on S with cone singularities, each cone angle being larger than 2π. Is there exactly one anti-de Sitter manifold with convex polyhedral boundary whose boundary carries the induced metrics h_- and h_+?

evidence.quote: Question 3.6. Let h−, h+ be two hyperbolic metrics on S with cone singularities of angle larger than 2π. Is there a unique AdS manifold with convex, polyhedral boundary for which the induced metric on the boundary is given by h− and h+?

accepted.question_text: For a globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter 3-manifold M with convex core C(M), is either the total volume V(M) or the convex-core volume V(C(M)) quasi-equivalent to a natural distance between the two induced metrics on the boundary of the convex core, or equivalently to a natural distance between the left and right hyperbolic metrics, such as the Teichmüller distance or the Weil-Petersson distance?

evidence.quote: Question 4.1. Is V (M) or V (C(M)) quasi-equivalent to a distance (for instance the Teichmüller distance, or the Weil–Petersson distance) between the induced metrics on the boundary of the convex core, or between the left and right hyperbolic metrics?

accepted.question_text: Among globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter 3-manifolds, is the total volume V(M) minimized exactly at the Fuchsian locus?

evidence.quote: Question 4.2. Is V (M) minimal at the Fuchsian locus?

accepted.question_text: Fix a closed surface S with Teichmüller space T(S) and fix h_l in T(S). For the unique globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter manifold M(h_l, h_r) having left and right hyperbolic metrics h_l and h_r, are the functions h_r ↦ V(M(h_l, h_r)) and h_r ↦ V(C(M(h_l, h_r))) on T(S) convex, are they proper, and do they each attain a unique minimum at h_r = h_l?
accepted.context_brief: Convexity and properness of AdS volumes

evidence.quote: Question 4.3. Are these functions convex? Are they proper? Do they have a unique minimum at hl?

accepted.question_text: Let M be a globally hyperbolic maximal compact manifold locally modeled on AdS^{n+1}. Must every Cauchy hypersurface of M be diffeomorphic to Γ\(H^p × H^q) for some uniform lattice Γ in SO(1,p) × SO(1,q) with p + q = n?
accepted.context_brief: Topology of Cauchy hypersurfaces in higher dimensions

evidence.quote: Question 5.1. Prove that the Cauchy surfaces of a GHMC manifold locally modeled on AdSn+1 are diffeomorphic to the quotient of Hp × Hq by a uniform lattice of SO(1, p) × SO(1, q) with p + q = n.

accepted.question_text: Is every globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter manifold a deformation of a GH-standard anti-de Sitter manifold, namely one obtained from a uniform lattice in SO(1,p) × SO(1,q) acting on the standard globally hyperbolic domain inside AdS^{n+1}?

evidence.quote: Question 5.2. Is every GHMC AdS manifold a deformation of a GH-standard AdS manifold?

accepted.question_text: For a globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter manifold of arbitrary dimension, does the past of its convex core always admit a K-time, meaning a time function whose level sets have constant Gauss-Kronecker curvature increasing with time?
accepted.context_brief: Existence of K-time in arbitrary dimension

evidence.quote: Question 6.1. Does the past of the convex core of a GHMC AdS manifold (of arbitrary dimension) always possess a K-time?

accepted.question_text: Let M be a globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter 3-manifold with particle singularities, each particle being a cone singularity along a time-like line with cone angle less than π. Is there exactly one maximal space-like surface in M that is orthogonal to all particle singularities?

evidence.quote: Question 6.2. Is there a unique maximal space-like surface in M orthogonal to the particles?

accepted.question_text: Let S be a closed surface with marked points x_1, ..., x_n and prescribed cone angles θ_1, ..., θ_n in (0, π). If h and h′ are hyperbolic metrics on S with cone singularities of angle θ_i at x_i, is there a unique minimal Lagrangian diffeomorphism isotopic to the identity and fixing each x_i between (S, h) and (S, h′)?
accepted.context_brief: Minimal Lagrangian maps with cone points

evidence.quote: Question 6.3. Let S be a closed surface. Choose x1, · · · , xn ∈ S and θ1, · · · , θn ∈ (0, π), and let h, h′ be two hyperbolic metrics on S with cone singularities of angle θi at xi. Is there a unique minimal Lagrangian diffeomorphism isotopic to the identity fixing the xi between (S, h) and (S, h′)?

accepted.question_text: Let M be a globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter 3-manifold with particle singularities of cone angle less than π. Does M admit a unique constant-mean-curvature time function whose every time slice is orthogonal to the singular locus?

evidence.quote: Question 6.4. Does M admit a unique CMC time with each surface of constant time orthogonal to the singularities?

accepted.question_text: Let M be a globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter 3-manifold with particle singularities of cone angle less than π. Does the past of the convex core of M, and likewise the future, admit a unique foliation by surfaces of constant Gauss curvature?
accepted.context_brief: Constant Gauss curvature foliations with particles

evidence.quote: Question 6.5. Does the past (resp. future) of the convex core of M have a unique foliation by constant Gauss curvature?

accepted.question_text: Let S be the interior of a compact surface with finitely many boundary components, let h_l and h_r be complete convex cocompact hyperbolic metrics on S, and let ρ_l, ρ_r : π1(S) -> PSL2(R) be their holonomy representations. Can one characterize the properness or non-properness of the action of (ρ_l, ρ_r)(π1(S)) on AdS^3 directly from geometric data on the convex core, such as the hyperbolic metrics on its boundary components or the bending laminations?

evidence.quote: Question 7.1. Let hl, hr ∈ TS and let ρl, ρr : π1(S) → PSL2(R) be the corresponding holonomies. How can one read the properness or non-properness of the action of (ρl, ρr)(π1(S)) on AdS3: • on the hyperbolic metrics of the boundary components of the convex core? • on the bending laminations?

accepted.question_text: Let T be the Teichmüller space of a closed surface, let T* T be its cotangent bundle, and let φ : T* T -> T × T be the map obtained by identifying a globally hyperbolic AdS 3-manifold both by its maximal-surface data (c, q) and by its left and right hyperbolic metrics. Is φ symplectic, meaning that the pullback of the difference of the Weil-Petersson symplectic forms on T × T equals, up to a constant factor, the canonical cotangent symplectic form on T* T?

evidence.quote: Question 8.1. Is φ symplectic, that is, is the pull-back by φ of the difference of the Weil–Petersson symplectic forms on the two factors in the image equal (up to a constant) to the cotangent symplectic structure on T∗T ?

accepted.question_text: Let ψ : S^1 -> S^1 be an orientation-preserving quasisymmetric homeomorphism. Does there exist a unique quasiconformal harmonic diffeomorphism φ : H^2 -> H^2 that extends continuously to the boundary at infinity and restricts there to ψ?
accepted.context_brief: Harmonic extension of quasisymmetric circle maps

evidence.quote: Question 8.2. Let ψ : S1 → S1 be an orientation-preserving quasi-symmetric homeomorphism. Is there a unique quasi-conformal harmonic diffeomorphism φ : H2 → H2 such that φ extends continuously at infinity and its restriction to the boundary at infinity of H2 is ψ?

accepted.question_text: Let Λ be the graph of a quasisymmetric homeomorphism RP^1 -> RP^1 in the conformal boundary of AdS^3, let C be the convex hull of Λ, and let D be the associated domain of dependence. Is there a unique foliation of D by space-like constant-mean-curvature surfaces having boundary at infinity Λ and uniformly bounded principal curvatures?
accepted.context_brief: CMC foliations in domains of dependence

evidence.quote: Question 8.3. Is there a unique foliation of D by space-like, constant mean curvature surfaces with bounded principal curvature and boundary at infinity Λ?

accepted.question_text: Let Λ be the graph of a quasisymmetric homeomorphism RP^1 -> RP^1 in the conformal boundary of AdS^3, let C be its convex hull, and let D be the associated domain of dependence. Is there a unique foliation of D \ C by space-like surfaces of constant Gauss curvature having boundary at infinity Λ and uniformly bounded principal curvatures?
accepted.context_brief: Constant Gauss curvature foliations outside the convex hull

evidence.quote: Question 8.4. Is there a unique foliation of D r C by space-like, constant Gauss curvature surfaces with bounded principal curvatures?

accepted.question_text: Let M = S × R with S a closed surface of genus at least 2. If l_- and l_+ are weighted multicurves on S that fill S, is there exactly one globally hyperbolic maximal compact anti-de Sitter structure h on M whose convex core boundary has measured bending laminations l_- and l_+?

evidence.quote: Question 9.1. If l− and l+ are weighted multi-curves which fill S, is there a unique GHMC AdS structure h on M such that l− and l+ are the measured bending laminations of the boundary of the convex core?

accepted.question_text: Let N be a closed anti-de Sitter 3-manifold with tachyon singularities along a link, where the holonomy around each component is a Lorentz boost and the absolute value of the boost gives the tachyon mass. Is the anti-de Sitter geometry of N locally rigid when the tachyon masses are held fixed?

evidence.quote: Question 9.2. Let N be a closed AdS manifold with tachyons, so that the singular locus is a link. Is the AdS geometry of N rigid relative to the tachyon mass?

accepted.question_text: Let N be a closed anti-de Sitter 3-manifold with tachyon singularities along a link, and assume the complement of the singular locus is atoroidal. Under this atoroidal hypothesis, is the anti-de Sitter geometry of N rigid when the tachyon masses are fixed?

evidence.quote: Question 9.3. Let N be a closed AdS manifold with tachyons, so that the singular locus is a link. Further, assume that the complement of the singular locus is atoroidal. Is the AdS geometry of N rigid relative to the tachyon mass?

accepted.question_text: Let N be a closed 3-manifold carrying a nonsingular anti-de Sitter structure, and let Σ be a link in N. Do there exist nearby anti-de Sitter structures with tachyon singularities along Σ, and if so, what topological or geometric conditions on the pair (N, Σ) are necessary for such deformations to exist?

evidence.quote: Question 9.5. Let N be a closed 3-manifold with a non-singular AdS structure and let Σ be a link in N. Do there exist nearby AdS structures with tachyon singularities along Σ? What topological conditions on (N, Σ) are needed to have such deformations? Geometric conditions?

accepted.question_text: Let S be a closed surface and let ρ_l and ρ_r be quasi-Fuchsian representations of π1(S) into PSL2(C). Does there exist a (ρ_l, ρ_r)-equivariant space-like embedding of the universal cover of S into the complex anti-de Sitter space X_C, and if such an embedding exists, can one choose one of constant curvature?

evidence.quote: Question 10.1. Given two quasi-Fuchsian representations of π1(S) into PSL2(C), is there an equivariant space-like embedding Se → XC? In this case, may we find such an embedding of constant curvature?

accepted.question_text: Let S be a closed surface and let ρ_l and ρ_r be quasi-Fuchsian representations of π1(S) into PSL2(C). Does there exist a maximal domain in the complex anti-de Sitter space X_C on which the subgroup (ρ_l, ρ_r)(π1(S)) of PSL2(C) × PSL2(C) acts properly discontinuously, and if so, what is the topology of the quotient of that domain?
accepted.context_brief: Proper domains for quasi-Fuchsian pairs in X_C

evidence.quote: Question 10.2. Given two quasi-Fuchsian representations ρl, ρr of π1(S) into PSL2(C), is there a (maximal) domain of XC where the action of the group (ρl, ρr)(π1(S)) ⊂ PSL2(C) × PSL2(C) is properly discontinuous? What is the topology of the corresponding quotient?

accepted.question_text: Let M be a hyperbolic 3-manifold and let ρ_l, ρ_r be convex cocompact representations of π1(M) into PSL2(C). Is there a maximal domain in the complex anti-de Sitter space X_C on which (ρ_l, ρ_r)(π1(M)) acts properly discontinuously, what is the topology of the quotient, and how can one read properness or non-properness of this action geometrically?
accepted.context_brief: Proper actions on X_C for 3-manifold groups

evidence.quote: Question 10.3. Let M be a hyperbolic 3-manifold and let (ρl, ρr) be a pair of convex cocompact representations of π1(M) into PSL2(C). Is there a (maximal) domain of XC where the action of the group (ρl, ρr)(π1(M)) ⊂ PSL2(C) × PSL2(C) is properly discontinuous? What is the topology of the corresponding quotient? How can one read geometrically the properness or non-properness of the action of (ρl, ρr)(π1(M)) ⊂ PSL2(C) × PSL2(C) on XC?
